extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to demonstrate the issue by tracing every path from row-level data to the test statistic and by recomputing all reported quantities. (1) Code trace: read_weekly_log groups rows by digester_id and phase; collapse_to_digesters averages within digester-phase and emits exactly one change per digester; main passes only that 12-element changes array to stats.wilcoxon. No week-level value reaches the test except through a within-digester mean, and no digester contributes more than one analysed value. (2) Numeric check for a disguised row-level test: I recomputed all 12 per-digester baseline and amended means and changes from data/input.csv and they match the report's table exactly; the mean change is exactly +2.500 and the range +1.55 to +3.25 as reported. With all 12 changes positive and no ties among distinct absolute changes, the exact two-sided Wilcoxon p-value is 2/2^12 = 0.00048828, matching the reported p = 0.000488 and W = 0.0. A test run on the 96 rows would not produce these values (a signed-rank test needs paired values; a 96-row pairing by week is not what the code constructs, and the reported n and p are uniquely consistent with n = 12). (3) I checked whether the reported n or degrees of freedom were inflated anywhere: n is reported as 12 throughout, and the 96-row figure appears only descriptively with the explicit statement that the readings 'were never entered as 96 independent observations.' The falsification attempt failed on all fronts, so the issue class is not demonstrated.
